source: Bertoni M, Telias I, Urner M, et al. A novel non-invasive method to detect excessively high respiratory effort and transpulmonary driving pressure during mechanical ventilation. Crit Care 2019; 23(1):346.
claim: During an end-expiratory occlusion manoeuvre, the maximum negative airway pressure deflection (ΔPocc) is proportional to muscular pressure (Pmus ≈ -0.75 × ΔPocc) and dynamic transpulmonary driving pressure; with Pmus = 16 cmH2O, ΔPocc reaches >= 18 cmH2O.
